definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing orders or policies that change so frequently they cannot be relied upon, criticizing inconsistent leadership.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: The company's policies keep changing and it's frustrating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}されて→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The public is jerked around by the government's constant policy changes.

examples.japanese: {朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ついてこない→ついてくる：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Subordinates won't follow a leader whose orders keep changing.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧)

LITERAL MEANING: {朝|あさ} (morning) + {令|れい} (order) + {暮|くれ} (evening) + {改|あらた}める (to change) = An order given in the morning is changed by evening.

ORIGIN: From the Chinese text 《{漢書|かんじょ}》 (Book of Han), referring to the chaos of the Qin dynasty.

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to constantly change policies)
・{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧＋noun (frequently changing ~)
・{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (policies are inconsistent)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (flip-flopping policies)
・{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be confused by constant changes)
・{朝令暮改|ちょうれいぼかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}される→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧ (to be jerked around by inconsistent orders)

NUANCE: Always negative, criticizing unreliable leadership or governance.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
・Flip-flopping
・Constant policy reversals
・Making it up as you go

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{一貫性|いっかんせい}→一貫性：05575_ikkansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - lacking consistency
・⟦{二転三転|にてんさんてん}→二転三転：18502_nitensanten⟧ - to change one's mind repeatedly
